Victoria (Finance): Quick heads-up — Q2 procurement & expense guidance. Effective June 1 we require a procurement approval + PO for any vendor spend >= $5,000. Small one-offs (< $5k) can go on corporate card but must include project/cost-center tags. New vendor onboarding MUST use the form: https://intra.redwood.com/forms/vendor-onboard :calendar:

Aisha (Finance Ops): Clarifying: date is June 1. Existing signed SOWs before Jun 1 are grandfathered, but please route invoices to ap@redwood.com and attach the SOW/PO if you have one. Our automated checks will start flagging missing POs after the cutoff. :rotating_light:

Marco (FP&A): Budget note — please tag Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted so we allocate spend correctly. Example tagging we expect in expense lines: 
```
cost_center=dedicated-eng
gl_account=5021
project_tag=RED-PRIV-42
```
This helps us map to Q2 forecasts and reserved capacity budgets.

Linus (Eng): Quick question — contractors buying single-user licenses (usually < $1k). Do they need a PO or just the card?

Aisha (Finance Ops): Short answer: if vendor is already approved and card use is allowed, purchases under $5k can use the card. Recurring subscriptions or any contract should get a PO/SOW so liabilities are tracked. To request a PO or confirm vendor status: procure@redwood.com (include vendor name, estimated spend, and linked project).

Rae (Legal): Also add — anything that involves customer data, access to infra, or vendor-hosted model evals needs Legal review before signature. Use the Contract Intake form: https://intra.redwood.com/contract-intake and @legal will triage.

Linus (Eng): Got it, will loop in procurement before we buy more eval GPUs. Thanks. :thumbsup:

ProcurementBot: Automated note — New vendor added to sandbox list: "NeonGPU LLC" approved as Tier B. Invoice routing: ap@redwood.com. If you need faster onboarding (Tier A) please submit vendor-onboard with SOC/ISO docs.

Victoria (Finance): TL;DR: >= $5k -> PO + procurement approval, tag all charges, use vendor/contract forms, ping procurement or finance ops with questions. We'll do a follow-up Q&A drop-in next week for teams with lots of small purchases. Thanks! :wave:
